fieldNotes.site: GM Defiance Operations (GM Powertrain Defiance Foundry / Casting), 26427 State Route 281, Defiance (Defiance County) OH 43512. Aluminum/iron foundry and machining center, ~1.9M sq ft, opened 1948 (first iron poured Aug 1948), ~530 hourly (UAW Local 211) per 2022 figures; casts cylinder blocks and heads for GM engines. The roster default geocode (41.2825,-84.4488) landed on farmland/Maumee River bend ~10km west of the plant - WRONG. State Route 281 runs east-west and the foundry sits on the SOUTH bank of the Maumee River about 5 miles east-northeast of downtown Defiance. Resolved the true plant center to ~41.2843,-84.3168 by satellite (large multi-roof foundry building, settling/cooling ponds, slag and sand storage to the north, employee lots fronting SR-281, rail sidings to the NE) corroborated by whereorg/americanautoworker listings at the SR-281 address.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Marked FALSE (medium confidence). The active truck entrance is on the WEST end of the SR-281 frontage (~41.2823,-84.3192): a wide paved driveway opens straight off SR-281 into an open truck yard. Street View (2025-05) and z19/z20 satellite show NO barrier arm, NO sliding gate, and NO guard booth at the road - the frontage is open. Foundry property does not present a fenced/gated truck checkpoint at this entrance. Flagged uncertain because a foundry of this scale may run an internal check-in not resolvable from the road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No staffed booth structure resolved at the west truck entrance in Street View or z19/z20 satellite. The eastern entrance (~41.2823,-84.3138) is an open employee/visitor drive into the parking lots with no booth. remoteGs FALSE as a consequence (no gate established).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: True - a very large open paved truck yard sits inside the property between the SR-281 frontage and the dock/freight buildings, providing ample internal holding/queue room before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: True - the open paved approach from SR-281 into the west truck yard is long and deep with room to queue well more than 3 trucks before reaching docks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: West drop yard holds organized rows of parked drop trailers - counted ~24 trailers in the west columns (z19) plus additional staged trailers along the building, banding 25-50. dropYard true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~18 dock doors (band 10-25) across the west and southwest freight building faces; trailers seen backed in (red tractors at docks). Foundry freight docks are modest relative to the 1.9M sq ft building. Exact count partly obscured by roof structures - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: True - inbound and outbound truck movements use the same open west driveway off SR-281; no separate dedicated out-gate identified.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: True - the west entrance is a very wide open paved apron with substantial unused width; ample physical room to add an express/bypass lane or a controlled check-in lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Marked false - freight (docks + drop yard) is concentrated on the west/southwest side; no clearly separate second dock cluster for ship vs receive confirmed.
fieldNotes.railServed: True - extensive rail sidings and spurs run into the north and northeast of the plant (multiple parallel tracks at ~41.2875,-84.310) serving the foundry's raw materials (sand, scrap, coke) and shipping.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the plant sits on the rural northeast edge of Defiance, surrounded by farmland and the Maumee River corridor, ~5 miles from the small downtown.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: False - a single large interconnected multi-roof foundry complex; buildingCount 1.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~235 acres for the traced active industrial footprint (building + truck yard + ponds + slag/sand storage). The full owned parcel including outlying land may be larger; perimeter excludes the farmland south of SR-281.

citations.claim: GM lists Defiance as an active GM aluminum foundry/machining center producing I4/V6/V8 cylinder blocks and head castings
GM investing $55M at Defiance for V8 block castings plus $8M for future EV castings; ~530 employees

verification.rationale: New GM-operated foundry (opened 1948), retained through 2009 and reinvested ($55M 2023); GM facility page lists it as active. Not a divested or RACER site (the RACER Ohio sale on record is a different facility).
